verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills includes a hosted Skills API with workspace-private skills, so asking whether an agent can get scoped credentials is a fair question for this agent-tooling ecosystem. The evidence never mentions issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. Nearby features do not count: subagent tool permissions, hooks that block operations, and controls over which skills Claude can invoke are runtime tool-access controls, not credential issuance.
